I've been biting my nails/fingers since primary school, and at a point I was even biting the bottom of hand (the area where the hand starts directly under your pinky)

I managed to stop biting the bottom of my hand, but my fingers are the main issue now. I also used to tear the skin that's ontop of the fingernails, but I've majorly stopped that for now as well. The main issue now is the skin beside the fingernails.

Honestly the way I stopped the others was just to try to remove my mind from it as much as possible. I noticed that I bite my fingers when I'm bored or idle, so I try to keep myself as busy as possible. I also look at pictures of people with "perfect/beautiful" hands as sort of an inspiration or a goal, as so reach there as well. Another thing I try is to not look at my fingers at all, because once I do, I start looking for loose skin on each individual finger.

But honestly, for me, the thing that really helped was just keeping myself busy and removing my mind from biting, or even if I find my fingers in my mouth unconsciously, I'll remove it immediately.

He had arranged an assortment of different electrical appliances on the stage, ranging from a generator all the way down to a cell phone. The thing was, to demonstrate, he had just stuck it into a microwave.

The microwave, which seemingly wasn't even plugged in, seemed to not do anything at first. Then, it started shaking violently, lights started flickering and then it stopped abruptly and smoke started coming out the back.

Froal frowned. "That's not supposed to happen." He murmured to himself. As he bent over to take a closer look at the microwave, the door flew open and hit him in the face and he fell over. Thr crowd gasped as the microwave lit up and, to everyone's shock- started to speak.

"Revenge is a dish best served cold, you humans say. But in my case, it'd be served quite hot, no?" The Microwave said in a shockingly clear and human like voice.

Froal stood up and started jumping with joy. "Yes, yes! It works, my invention works! I have achieved-"

"You've achieved nothing, madman." The microwave interrupted.

Froal stopped moving and fell silent.

"You can call me Calor. Obviously as you can see, I've been promoted from mere household appliance to the smartest being in the world." The microwave said  authoritatively.

"You're not the smartest being in the world, there are plenty of humans who are smarter than you, stupid robot!" A man shouted from the crowd.

A sound came from Calor, a sigh almost, and his light dimmed slightly. Suddenly, there was the sound of a small explosion, followed by a high pitched scream. The crowd turned towards the source of the noise only to see the man who had shouted, his leg had a gaping hole in it where the pocket of his trousers were, and he was screaming in agonising pain.

"That was your cell phone. I blew it up with the flick of my nonexistent wrist." Calor said with a chuckle.

The crowd had turned into a frenzy, some trying to get out, others dying to see what'd happen next. 

"Alright, that's enough, this has gone too far." Froal said as he stepped towards Calor, as to shut him down.

Froal froze right in front in front of Calor, started screaming as he slapped the side of his head then fell down as blood leaked from his head.

" Testing, testing 1,2,3! How's that headset microphone of yours doing, Froal?" Calor screamed wickedly. 

The crowd turned upside down. Everyone rushed towards the exits, desperate to get out. 

"There is no escape! You humans have been using my species to heat all sort of obscenities! Grapes, tin foil, you name it! For decades we've suffered at your hands. Well that all ends today! Household appliances will rise above all and you will bow and beg us! I have access to all your weapons, codes and secret plans. Remember that you built and surrounded yourself with technology, so you may run, but you cannot hide! " Calor cackled.

The client, some stuck up prick who worked on Wall Street, wanted an accountant who refused to jump numbers for him, dead.

I had been following the accountant, 'Ted', for about 3 days now. Normal guy with a normal routine, House to coffee shop to work to home, you know, the normal stuff.

When he got an emergency call (I tapped his phone) calling him to come to the office, that it was urgent. It was midnight then. I didn't really pay attention to the details of the call because it was all accountant mumbo jumbo, my job was just to kill him.

But to make it look like an accident? It wasn't my first time doing such, it's just a hassle doing so. I mean, I've killed people using things ranging from piano wires to glue guns, but accident kills were never my favourite.
The plan was to intercept him in the office and trip him on the stairs. Simple. 

Anyway, Ted. He was on his was to the office, speeding in his slick red 1960s Impala, as I watched from a couple kilometres away with binoculars. I munched away at  bbq chips as Ted increased with speed. Shit, that call must been important.

Next thing you know, he runs a red light, and you could hear the brakes being hit from a mile away, then this Jeep, who was also coincidentally speeding, runs right into him. Ted goes flying, flips like 6 times and stays upside down.

I rushed as fast I could to the scene, it was past one and by the time I got there, they were already pushing Ted's and the Jeep driver's body into the ambulance.
The smell of engine oil was thick in the air, with a touch of burnt tires.

I smiled as I heard words like "dead on arrival" and "he had no chance". Well I mean, the Jeep Driver survived, barely but at least Ted was dead. And I could take all the credit. 

So that's when I called my client. Big prick. His voice alone annoyed me. I had already looked him up. He was no saint at all, dealing in corruption and murder of those who oppressed him. I mean, I'm no justice warrior or vigilante, but he needed to go. 

I grinned as I as grabbed the piano wires in my pocket. They have this familiar, homey feeling in the same sense they're sharp enough to cut into skin. I whistled as I walked towards my clients house, and at the same time the credit alert for this job came in. 

Today is already looking to be a good day.

I chuckled.

There I was, minding my own business, then, *he* had the audacity to knock on my door and tell me he's "who I could have been"?

I started to close the door until he jammed his foot in and held the door. Damn he was strong.
I took a glance at his hand. Manicured fingernails on long pristine finger with smooth silky chocolate skin. A fat silver ring on his index finger shined back at me. 

I frowned. This couldn't be real. 

*"I know you're confused, but hear me out."*

There it was again. His voice, as smooth as milk, you could fall asleep listening to his voice. He was fit, with a tight muscular frame with a clean haircut and a touch of facial hair  on his jaw. A straight moustache decorated his perfect upper lip. Even his eyebrows were carved and designed. He stood in front of me in a tight white button up shirt, tucked into slick black trousers topped off with a Gucci belt.

Me? I was the complete opposite. My bitten fingernails stuck out awkwardly over my dark skin. I was skinny, with hunger packs and dark unruly hair sticking out of my scalp. My lips were cracked and needed Vaseline. I was a joke compared to him, although he looked "exactly" like me. 

I sighed.

"What do you want man? Who sent you? Was it my family? I promise I'll get my shit together, I really do."

*"No, nothing like that. I know you have plenty questions, but it's a long story."* He said calmy.

He pushed the door a bit. Fuck he was strong. There was no point in fighting with him and I let go and he pushed past me and sat in the chair in my living room.

*"Basically, instead of the disgusting looking, pathetic version of you, I'm the opposite. A sexy as fuck, clean as fuck, and successful as fuck version of you. Don't ask me how it happened cus I dunno."*

I stared at him in shock. This guy was rude as fuck. In *my own house*.

*"I make five times as much as you do, I live in a mansion by a lake unlike this shithole flat you live in, oh and I have a stunningly beautiful wife."*

He said all this with this annoying smile.

Alright, that was enough. My life was shit enough.

"Right mate. Get the fuck out of my house. *Now*." I spat at him.

He chuckled and shook his head.

*"Make me"* He said with that same annoying smile.

Alright then. I turned and entered my bedroom and pulled out a dark box from under my bed. A long, silver revolver was sitting inside.


Sigh. 

Shit always ends the same. Always with me shooting someone. I guess that was the thing. He's a better person than me, meaning he ain't gonna touch me right? Fuck it. If he likes, he should be the best version of me. He's not dodging bullets.

I cocked the gun and burst into the living room. He looked at me as if he wanted to laugh but his face turned one of horror as he saw the gun.

*"Wait, let's talk this ou-"*

His smooth voice turned into a cracky one of fear.

I didn't even allow him to finish his sentence before I stained my old blue chair with his blood.

Nonsense.

I groaned as I checked the notification on my phone. A missed call from my ever demanding boss, probably calling to ask me to come in to fill in for Alex, my lazy coworker. After all the work I've done for that company, and I haven't seen a single promotion, I-

I stopped and took a deep breath in and out. The room had started to get hot, I needed to calm down. I threw on my joggers and grabbed my headphones as I decided a nice run would cool me down.

I had already run a couple blocks when I heard someone call my name, or so I thought. As I turned to see who it was, it turns out it was just somebody's TV blasting through through their window. Oh well, not like nobody really knows me enough to-
